data.short_description: Locust Cider's Gig Harbor taproom has changed owners and reopened as The Harbor Hideout under new owner Arthur Rodenhauser. Existing staff and arcade games are staying, and Locust Cider will remain on tap.

data.status: exact opening date has not been set
data.short_description: Emberance plans to open at Hilton Phoenix Resort at The Peak, a 7,366-square-foot restaurant serving breakfast, lunch, and dinner led by Chef Mireya Ryan. The menu draws from Sonoran Desert ingredients.

data.status: targeting November 7 for a soft opening
data.short_description: Juke Garden, a Black-owned cocktail lounge and event space, plans to open in Tacoma's Hilltop neighborhood with a dance floor, DJ platform, and private karaoke room. Owner Andrew Green is developing it with the Clubless Collective team.
